name: Coral Oasis
purpose: Technical schematic for new v2 art exploration, not final art, Unity scene, or production driving geometry.

coordinates.suggestedUnityMapping: (guideX, guideY) -> (X, Z), with Z sign chosen for camera composition

route.turnIntent: Long straights and flowing S bends with broad 20/30 degree local deflections; broad continuous arcs around landscape features. No tight hairpins, perimeter ring, or same-grade crossing.

journeySubzones: Interior turquoise oasis and palm shelf

scaleExample.note: Illustrative conversion only. Actual traversal timing depends on camera, movement, elevation, pauses, and final Unity route. Timing is not guaranteed.

artHandoff.road: One wide uninterrupted physical road with a natural edge; never convert into stepping-stone tiles.
artHandoff.landscape: Three readable landscape subzones; irregular expansive terrain around the road; route repeatedly enters the island interior.
artHandoff.passages: Only short bridges or open-ended arches where indicated; keep road entry and exit visible. No long invisible tunnel.
artHandoff.grade: Initial reference has no same-grade crossing and no forced shared traversal.
